source: A survey of 3,716 characters (every jōyō compound and a stratified draw from outside it), each redrawn with nothing taken from it in sans, serif and kaisho. hard: worst 10% in all three by aligned overlap. tracking: square-root stratified over operator and jōyō membership, seed 2026, less the hard set.
